== Problem 1 ==

Follows-up 52a999214c. Adding Node 26 to the matrix passed at
https://github.com/qunitjs/qunit/actions/runs/36519183067/job/109248101306

.. which was on a branch where we happen to get a lucky cache hit:

> Cache hit for:
> Linux-0954bc9ce1cd42bd80bacb333df74f2e5c96b95d72a08fed99ac934a417781bc

Then the same SHA1 was pushed to master, where it fails:

https://github.com/qunitjs/qunit/actions/runs/36519530591/job/109249132879
> Cache not found for input keys:
> Linux-0954bc9ce1cd42bd80bacb333df74f2e5c96b95d72a08fed99ac934a417781bc
>
> npm warn install-scripts 1 package has install scripts not yet covered by allowScripts:
> npm warn install-scripts   puppeteer@24.43.1 (postinstall: node install.mjs)

== Problem 2 ==

puppeteer 24 (grunt-contrib-qunit 10.x) is incompatible with Node 26
due to an issue with extract-zip, which was not fixed until puppeteer 25.

puppeteer 25 drops support for Node 18, which means we have to use
either grunt-contrib-qunit 10 (puppeteer 24) or 11 (puppeteer 25)

Ref https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/issues/14957

== Problem 3 ==

`npm install` does not honor engines.node requirements correctly

This was seemingly fixed in npm 10.8, and the last Node.js 18
release is 18.20.8 (March 2025) which bundled npm 10.8.2. Yay?

Ref https://github.com/npm/cli/issues/6743
